title.en: Friendship and the characters of Badal and Moti

text.en: Badal found a shivering puppy on his way home and brought it to his mother. She said yes, if he promised to look after it.

In this story, Badal lives with his mother in a village. One evening he sees a puppy shivering in the cold and brings it home.
His mother lets him keep the puppy if he promises to take care of it. They name the puppy Moti.
Moti grows up and loves Badal. They eat, play and go everywhere together, and become best friends.
One rainy day Badal slips on a muddy lane and falls into a deep pit. He cannot climb out.
His mother is worried when he does not come home. She gathers the neighbours, and Moti goes with them.
Moti catches Badal's scent, follows it to the pit and barks. The neighbours hear him and pull Badal out with a rope.
Badal hugs Moti and thanks him. The story shows that kindness comes back to us and that animals can be true friends.
New words to learn: puppy, shivering, scent, pit, rope.
